settings.text:
The Outdoor Duo pairs UV Shield+ and Skinbiotic+ in one dermatologist-formulated daily routine.

UV Shield+ is built around nutritional and antioxidant support for skin exposed to environmental and UV-related stress. Skinbiotic+ supports gut health, microbiome balance, and the gut-skin connection.

Together, they create a simple two-step bundle for people who spend significant time outdoors and want to support skin from both the environmental and internal sides of the equation.

settings.heading: Two complementary forms of internal skin support.
settings.body:
The Outdoor Duo combines two formulas with different primary roles.

It is not built around taking more products for the sake of taking more products. It is built around combining two different biological support strategies in one routine.

settings.heading: Why pair UV Shield+ with Skinbiotic+?
settings.body:
UV Shield+ primarily targets nutritional and antioxidant pathways relevant to environmental stress. Skinbiotic+ primarily targets the gut and microbial environment.

These are different starting points, which is exactly why the pairing makes sense. The two products operate through different upstream mechanisms that may converge on broader systemic signaling.
settings.note: This diagram represents formulation rationale. It does not mean the finished bundle has been clinically tested as a combined regimen.

settings.heading: UV Shield+
settings.subhead: Daily support for active, sun-ready skin
settings.body:
UV Shield+ combines five ingredients selected for complementary nutritional and antioxidant roles:

  • Niacinamide
  • Polypodium leucotomos
  • EGCG
  • Trans-resveratrol
  • Spirulina

The formula’s strength lies in covering several aspects of environmental and oxidative-stress biology rather than depending on one single mechanism.

Key support areas: environmental stress, antioxidant support, skin resilience, outdoor lifestyle support.

settings.heading: Skinbiotic+
settings.subhead: Daily probiotic for gut and skin health
settings.body:
Skinbiotic+ combines organic inulin with multiple probiotic organisms in a synbiotic formula designed around gut health and the gut-skin connection.

The formulation rationale focuses on prebiotic support, multi-organism microbiome support, and complementary microbial roles.

Key support areas: gut-skin connection, microbiome balance, synbiotic support, daily internal balance.

settings.heading: Skin support works in layers.
settings.body: A complete routine has more than one layer.
settings.callout: The Outdoor Duo belongs inside a complete skin-health routine, not instead of one.

settings.title: Smart sun habits
settings.text: Protective clothing, hats, shade, and reapplication.

settings.heading: Outdoor exposure is more than a surface event.
settings.body:
Sunlight and environmental exposure can influence oxidative stress and other cellular responses in skin.

UV Shield+ is formulated around nutritional and antioxidant support for those internal systems.
settings.quote: Internal support does not replace external protection.

settings.heading: The gut and skin communicate.
settings.body:
The gut-skin axis refers to biological communication between the intestinal environment and the skin through pathways involving:

  • Microbial metabolites
  • Immune signaling
  • Barrier integrity
  • Nutrient metabolism

Skinbiotic+ is designed to support the intestinal side of that relationship. It is a synbiotic formula combining inulin with multiple probiotic organisms selected around gut and skin-related biological rationale.

settings.heading: Is Outdoor Duo the right bundle for you?

settings.question: What is the Outdoor Duo?
settings.answer: The Outdoor Duo combines UV Shield+ and Skinbiotic+ in a two-product routine designed to support environmental skin resilience and the gut-skin connection.

settings.question: Why are these two products paired?
settings.answer: They focus on different areas of internal support: UV Shield+ emphasizes environmental and antioxidant support, while Skinbiotic+ emphasizes microbiome and gut-skin support.

settings.question: Does the Outdoor Duo replace sunscreen?
settings.answer: No. It is designed to complement sunscreen and smart sun habits, not replace them.

settings.question: How do I take the bundle?
settings.answer: Take each product according to its own label directions. UV Shield+: Take two (2) capsules once daily with water. For enhanced support, take two (2) capsules twice daily with water. Skinbiotic+: Take one (1) capsule daily with water.

settings.question: Can I buy the products individually?
settings.answer: Yes. Both UV Shield+ and Skinbiotic+ are available separately.

settings.question: Can I subscribe to the Outdoor Duo?
settings.answer: Yes. The plan options in the purchase box show the current subscription and one-time purchase options.

settings.question: Is this the same as Tria Prima?
settings.answer: No. Outdoor Duo contains UV Shield+ and Skinbiotic+. Tria Prima also includes Dermaboost+.
